derivative_notice: Sanitized copy; original private source remains unchanged.

record.review_kind: read-only static review of the actual edit-loop call chain

conclusion.content_path: The reviewed open, read, caption-position write, save, reopen, render and close paths use native COM/document objects and local file processing.
conclusion.prohibited_ui_automation_in_actual_chain: Not found: mouse or keyboard input, menu commands, UI Automation, clipboard access, foreground-focus input, screen-coordinate clicks or drags.
conclusion.qualification: Static source evidence only. This is not proof of native execution, headless operation, chemical correctness, preservation equivalence, visual quality or general object-editing capability.

actual_chain.notes: Fresh process identity and zero initial documents are checked; no GUI startup fallback.
The retained document object is opened from the copied native file.
Reads use the retained document, not the current Selection or clipboard. Local XML parsing supplies complete document comparisons.
Only the selected caption position is written in this actual chain. Coordinates are document coordinates, not screen coordinates or simulated dragging.
CDXML and CDX are written through the retained document; resulting file existence and bytes are checked.
The native PNG is preserved. The white preview is a derived image; neither is obtained through a window screenshot. PNG-export object comparisons are separately checked.
Reopen requires a different fresh native PID and creates a new document binding. A successful outer operation is not a preservation-equivalence assertion.
The reviewed path uses retained COM objects and ownership guards; it has no menu or window-button fallback.

activation_and_identity.distinction: Activation changes application display/document state through COM; it is not simulated input. The code explicitly depends on the retained document being the application's ActiveDocument.
limitations: No claim that activation preserves the operating-system foreground window.
No proof that a hidden, noninteractive or headless native session can execute this chain.
The only reviewed user32 import is the read-only GetWindowThreadProcessId identity lookup.

gaps_and_acceptance_rules.observation: Cross-save and cross-reopen comparisons are retained as detail.normalization. Their ok value is not automatically classified into semantic preservation equivalence before the outer operation response.
gaps_and_acceptance_rules.interpretation: Outer operation ok != preservation equivalence. It must not support a general lossless-save or lossless-reopen claim.
gaps_and_acceptance_rules.known_normalization_context: The coordinator reports independent no-edit controls with native page/arrow/scheme ID, Z and reference reassignments. This static review did not read those control artifacts or independently verify their equivalence. Fractional-coordinate quantization requires its own independent assessment.
gaps_and_acceptance_rules.disposition: Keep normalization=false evidence intact and review differences independently. A future classifier should reject unexplained changes or return needs_review; do not simply reject all false comparisons or automatically accept all ID reassignment.
gaps_and_acceptance_rules.narrow_result_boundary: Independently checked before/after evidence may establish the bounded caption edit without establishing general cross-reopen preservation.

gaps_and_acceptance_rules.observation: Close/Quit returns and document counts are recorded, but this chain contains no qualified machine-interface recovery for a residual or blank native window after document close.
gaps_and_acceptance_rules.disposition: If such a residual window remains, report the limitation and preserve its evidence. No GUI, menu, keyboard or focus-based fallback is authorized by this machine-interface path.
gaps_and_acceptance_rules.limitation: Do not infer that all native windows/processes exited or that headless operation is supported merely because Close or Quit returned.

exclusions: No native or GUI calls were run by this review.
No retained samples, hidden targets, old 055 data, M2, descendants or holdouts were read.
Other atom, arrow, spline and lone-pair bridge methods exist but are outside the actual caption-edit call chain and receive no capability endorsement.
